messages.subject: Sort DataTables by numeric data
parts:
I have a data frame with both numeric and character data.  This appears to be causing the DataTable to sort the numeric data as a string variable. For example:

1
10
15
2
22
3
4
44

How can I adjust the following code to fix this issue?



   output$assetstatsTable <- renderDataTable(function(){
     data = as.data.frame(getData())
     data
   })


Thanks!
Josh

messages.subject: Re: Sort DataTables by numeric data
parts:
Sorry, but I cannot reproduce it using the example below:

library(shiny)
runApp(list(
ui = basicPage(dataTableOutput('foo')),
server = function(input, output) {
output$foo = renderDataTable({
data.frame(x = c(1, 10, 15, 2, 22, 3), y = letters[1:6])
})
}
))

When I click on the column x, it is sorted as expected: 1, 2, 3, 10, 15, 22

My guess is that your "numeric" column is not really numeric. Perhaps
you converted it to characters unconsciously somewhere. I can
reproduce the problem when x is character:

library(shiny)
runApp(list(
ui = basicPage(dataTableOutput('foo')),
server = function(input, output) {
output$foo = renderDataTable({
data.frame(x = as.character(c(1, 10, 15, 2, 22, 3)), y =
letters[1:6], stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
})
}
))

And that is expected since sorting character strings will make 10
"smaller" than 2, for example.

Regards,
Yihui
